interpretation: User approximately 1-Hz red blink is closer to the error pattern than the 10-second low-battery pattern. This does not diagnose a failed component or prove an exact 1-Hz code. Complete antenna/motor bench configuration and startup calibration conditions still matter.
action: Record state without factory reset or changing the existing PIC configuration. Resolve TP14 voltage conflict, then review receiver/reference behavior.
